correctness.rationale: The even-subgraph partition function and mixed fugacity derivatives yield exact incident and disjoint covariance kernels for all t!=1. For low density strict variance of the latent Y=tanh^2(H) proves positivity; for high density complementation shows odd n retains positivity and even n has r2=m_j/m_(j+1)>1, while strict log-convexity m_(j-1)m_(j+1)>m_j^2 keeps the disjoint covariance positive. For p=1/2 pairwise independence follows from minimum cut size n-1>=3. Exact independent cycle-space enumeration and Fourier sums passed 112 assertions across n=4..7. No finite test stands in for the general analytic proof.

value.rationale: The law classifies the full finite-order and density phase diagram of pairwise conditional edge dependence in a classical even-degree random graph. Its shared-endpoint sign reversal in high-density even order, versus disjoint-edge persistent positivity and odd-order positive dependence, is a structural parity effect with clear inferential relevance to conditioned network edges. This is not a small numerical sample or a mere direct recitation of the known Ising mapping.
